silently repair, delete, or rewrite a missing, orphaned, stale, malformed, or mismatched trace-anchor state
change repository visibility, access, or ownership

add deterministic sibling anchor serialization, exact verification, durable file flush, fsync, and same-directory atomic replacement

units.purpose: Run public v0.0.16, inspect its evaluations and real live traces, and prove one endpoint-integrity weakness without mutating released evidence.

The first public-tag dashboard preview displayed the known all-dark viewer artifact; reopening unchanged bytes at high detail displayed the full correct dashboard.

units.purpose: Gate official filesystem sources and freeze exact endpoint anchoring, failure, recovery, portability, and non-claim requirements before candidate implementation.
Implement one bounded durable live endpoint-anchor improvement without changing model or execution authority.
Reveal the frozen held-out cases once and run every prior source, package, API, MCP, state, telemetry, dashboard, and clean-clone gate.
retained_failures: The first bare evaluator invocation omitted the documented PYTHONPATH and failed before any case executed.
A PowerShell UTC display probe used an unavailable Get-Date -AsUTC option; the manifest generator independently wrote and validated its UTC timestamp.
The first packaged API pass served the source evaluation pointer and was superseded by an exact rerun against the immutable package report.

The first otherwise-passing source/package dashboard placed the persisted-incidents table below the 1440 by 1000 evidence frame; its archive, screenshots, and native receipts remain retained as superseded attempt 001.

The second otherwise-passing dashboard showed a persisted-incident row clipped at the lower edge during exact original-detail inspection; candidate 773c539 and its archive, screenshots, native receipts, and clean-clone outputs remain retained as superseded attempt 002.

A --help probe against the non-argument baseline runner stopped at the expected manifest mismatch before the revised manifest freeze; the non-argument MCP verifier also ran once. Neither output was selected.

units.purpose: Version, package, review, merge, publish, and verify the bounded checkpoint only if every gate passes.
